title: Moral Lenses, Political Coordinates: Towards Ideological Positioning of Morally Conditioned LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces a moral-political evaluation framework that conditions LLMs on specific ethical frameworks (utilitarianism, deontology) and moral foundations (Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, Purity) using psychometric instruments like the Moral Foundations Questionnaire and the Oxford Utilitarianism Scale.
